vectors.mastery_target: Track evaluation-data access and overlaps between training, memory, and held-out fixtures; a contaminated run is excluded from improvement evidence with an inspectable reason.
vectors.progress: PARTIAL (refuted on record in .agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-201-009.json): (T-GAWDSWARM-DIAMOND-1, 2026-11-07): the production eval path now consumes a durable access log as well as caller-declared sets. eval_contamination::record_access, the producer every fixture reader must call, appends each fixture read ({split: training|memory, id}) to workspace/.susi/eval_access_log.jsonl under the eval_access file lock, and load_recorded_access reads it back. eval_separation::evaluate_and_record (the 'susi tasks eval-corpus' path) merges the logged reads into the run's training/memory access before detect_in_corpus, so a held-out read in the log is judged contaminated and excluded even when the caller's EvalRunInput leaves it out. Verified by vc_201_009_mastery_evaluate_and_record_catches_disk_logged_held_out_read and vc_201_009_mastery_access_log_tolerates_missing_and_torn_lines in `crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_009_mastery.rs`. Residual: no production fixture reader calls record_access yet (only the mastery test does), so in practice the log is empty and contamination still rests on caller-declared sets until readers are instrumented. Delivery history: PARTIAL: a recorded id overlap flags with an inspectable reason, detect_in_corpus now resolves accessed ids to content hashes so identical held-out content under another id is caught, and exclude_if_contaminated is a real gate on the report. Verified by `crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_009_mastery.rs`. Production caller landed (T-DEEPSEEK-234): eval_separation's evaluate/evaluate_and_record runs detect_in_corpus before trusting a promotion verdict, reachable on 'susi tasks eval-corpus'. Residual: that caller's access sets are still caller-declared, not derived from an actual read log, so an unrecorded held-out read still reports clean. Verdict `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-201-009.json`. Follow-up tracked by T-DEVIN20261002053148-20.

vectors.mastery_target: Compare a candidate on ~/.susi-dev and ports 9190-9194 using an isolated evaluation workload; crossing a declared regression limit stops the trial without replacing the installed release.
vectors.progress: PARTIAL (refuted on record in .agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-201-017.json): (T-GAWDSWARM-DIAMOND-1, 2026-11-07): the canary gate now has a production caller. dev_canary::canary_gate_from_scorecard builds a zero-tolerance CanaryTrial per scorecard dimension (quality against spec.quality.threshold, latency against spec.latency.threshold, and the other three, each in its own direction) on the pinned dev_instance_ports() 9190-9194 band, and evaluate_and_record runs it before promote_with_scorecard. A StopTrial keeps the experiment Evaluated, writes no release candidate, and is recorded on EvalEvidence.canary. Verified by vc_201_017_mastery_canary_gate_from_scorecard_compares_measured_to_spec and vc_201_017_mastery_canary_gate_blocks_promotion_on_production_eval_path. The second test is a negative-uncertainty scorecard that summary_ok would promote and the canary stops. Residual: the canary judges the evaluator's measured scorecard; no live workload is launched against ~/.susi-dev by this module. Delivery history: PARTIAL: a caller-supplied delta over a finite limit stops the trial, and a non-finite metric or a non-finite/negative limit now stops it too instead of reading as 'no regression'; dev_instance_ports() always returns the pinned 9190-9194 band with no caller-supplied base. Residual: no canary executes — the inputs are pre-measured floats, and dev_canary has no caller outside tests. Refuted on record; tracked by T-DEVIN20261002053148-24.

vectors.mastery_target: Store failure causes, counterexamples, and proposal lineage in scoped experiment memory; repeated proposals must address the previous rejection or explicitly declare new evidence.
vectors.progress: PARTIAL (refuted on record in .agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-201-019.json): (T-GAWDSWARM-DIAMOND-1, 2026-11-07): ExperimentMemory is durable and on both production paths. ExperimentMemory::load/save persist workspace/.susi/experiment_memory.json through atomic_replace_file under a file lock. eval_separation::evaluate_and_record records every Rejected run (cause = verdict, counterexample = contamination reason, lineage = corpus revision) via record_rejection_in_memory. It also refuses a candidate that repeats a recorded rejection, by id or by identical cause and counterexample under a new id, unless its non-blank actual_output is fresh evidence. cloud_rsi::run_proposals calls check_proposal_memory after validation whenever ProposalPolicy.experiment_memory is set, and the cloud_rsi_e2e Campaign reloads it from its workspace every generation; a repeat must cite the prior id or a supplied failure receipt or it is refused as PriorRejection. Verified by vc_201_019_mastery_experiment_memory_save_load_roundtrip, vc_201_019_mastery_evaluate_and_record_persists_rejections_and_refuses_repeats and vc_201_019_mastery_cloud_proposal_check_consults_experiment_memory and cloud_rsi_e2e_remembered_rejection_blocks_repeat_proposal. Delivery history: PARTIAL: the OutcomeLedger half is real — scoped, persisted counterexamples that reject invented references — and now requires a non-blank receipt as fresh evidence while the cap evicts the oldest failure instead of the newest. ExperimentMemory now recognizes a repeat by (cause, counterexample) content under a fresh id and checks real evidence instead of caller booleans. Residual: check_proposal has no production caller. Refuted on record; tracked by T-DEVIN20261002053148-26.
